title: OSM Lagos contextual features
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
processing: Repeatable Overpass extraction with source IDs and unmodified tags. Features are classified without merging with Blue Lagos field records.
limitations: OSM completeness and positional accuracy vary. Landing candidates and waterways are unverified and must not be treated as official or navigable.
confidence: Contextual only until matched against authoritative or field evidence
